newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analysts' comments on Aegon Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on Aegon Q1 results.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV on Thursday announced a 24 percent increase in net profit to 403 million guilders for the first quarter of 1997.
Below is a collection of analysts' comments on the results.

"My first quarter forecast was 375 million guilders. The growth in premium income was extremely good. I am increasing my EPS estimates for the full year to 7.20 guilders from 7.00 guilders, including Providian. Providian provides about 30 cents per share."

"It's much better than had been expected. We were looking at 384 million guilders. It was better across the board. Life insurance (was good). General insurance was quite positive. It was excellent in health. I think my estimates will move up slightly, by 10-15 cents per share at least, from 6.95 cents. I was looking for an increase in net profit in the full year of 13 percent. The company has forecast 15 percent, which is also conservative."
